# City-Data.com

> > Comprehensive database of U.S. cities and towns with detailed demographics, real estate, crime statistics, cost of living, schools, and local business information.

City-Data.com provides data-driven profiles for thousands of American cities, covering population statistics, housing markets, crime rates, education, and quality of life metrics. The site serves residents, prospective movers, researchers, and anyone seeking detailed municipal data across all 50 states.

## Key Topics

- Demographics and population statistics
- Real estate and housing data
- Crime statistics and safety metrics
- Cost of living comparisons
- Median income and poverty rates
- School data and education information
- City profiles and directories
- Pollution and environmental data
- Local business listings
- Relocation and moving resources
- ZIP code information
- State-level city directories
- Municipal comparisons

## State City Directories

- [Alabama Cities Directory](https://www.city-data.com/city/Alabama.html): Directory of Alabama cities over 6000 residents with demographics, real estate, crime data, schools, and pollution statistics
- [Arizona Cities Directory](https://www.city-data.com/city/Arizona.html): Directory of Arizona cities over 6000 residents with housing, demographics, school information, and crime statistics

## City Profiles

- [Bellmore, New York Profile](https://www.city-data.com/city/Bellmore-New-York.html): Complete profile for Bellmore NY (ZIP 11710): population, income, cost of living, real estate, crime, schools, hospitals, and local businesses
- [Lake Havasu City, Arizona Profile](https://www.city-data.com/city/Lake-Havasu-City-Arizona.html): Lake Havasu City AZ profile (ZIP 86406): demographics, median income, London Bridge area, housing statistics, and relocation information
- [Boise, Idaho Profile](https://www.city-data.com/city/Boise-City-Idaho.html): Boise ID city profile: population statistics, cost of living, Greenbelt area data, real estate, crime, schools, and employment information
